_comment: Rename this file to free-config.json to enable the assistant's Free mode. Put an OpenRouter key here whose credit limit is set to 0 on openrouter.ai so only :free models can run — extracting it from the app then costs nothing. free-config.json is gitignored (kept out of the repo) but IS bundled into packaged builds so end users get Free mode. 'models' is optional; omit it to use the built-in fallback chain.
